title: The Lost Roman Ninth Legion
hook: Why did an entire Roman legion vanish without a trace?
headline: The Roman legion that disappeared

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: The last attested activity of the Ninth Legion at York was in AD 108; it is not known to have been stationed there in AD 122.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: A 2nd-century stone inscription near York mentions the legion's presence clearly.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Tacitus wrote that the legion mysteriously vanished during a northern campaign in Britain.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Recent archaeology suggests a mass grave at Camlann may hold legion remains, supporting theories.

end.line: What really happened to the Ninth Legion?

description: Explore the mystery of the Roman Ninth Legion's disappearance.

facts.claim: The Ninth Legion (Legio IX Hispana) was stationed at Eboracum (York) in AD 122
A 2nd-century stone inscription near York references Legio IX Hispana
Tacitus mentions the disappearance of a Roman legion in Britain
Archaeologists have identified a possible mass grave at Camlann linked to the legion
